newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi welcomes Italy opposition talks, but prudent.
newsitem.headline: Prodi welcomes Italy opposition talks, but prudent.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi, who met centre-right opposition leader Silvio Berlusconi earlier for talks on cooperation, said on Friday he welcomed the overture but remained "prudent".

In a speech to a congress of the Democratic Party of the Left (PDS), Prodi also said that he was certain his ruling majority would hold. Prodi relies on support from the hardline Communist Refoundation party for a parliamentary majority.
